task-defaults:
    run-on-repo-type: [hg]
    description: Pushes Flatpaks onto Flathub
    run-on-projects: []  # to make sure this never runs as part of CI
    run-on-releases: [beta, release, esr153]
    shipping-phase: ship

implementation: push-flatpak
        channel:
            by-release-type:
                beta: beta
                release: stable
                esr.*: stable
                default: mock

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: 571 maps the historical ESR 128 Flatpak release to stable. Current code uses an esr.* channel pattern but separately lists eligible releases, currently esr153, in run-on-releases. A stable channel mapping does not by itself schedule every ESR, and the old explicit version is not a permanent rule. Keep both the release gate and channel mapping when updating release versions. No release graph or publishing task was run.
title: Separate release eligibility from a package publishing channel
